_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor from Strapi's documentation; no upstream egg.
name: Strapi
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Strapi is an open-source headless CMS with a REST and GraphQL API. The egg runs your project from a Git repository, or makes a new one with SQLite; open /admin to create the first administrator. Building the admin interface needs about 3 GB of memory.
startup: export STRAPI_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true STRAPI_DISABLE_UPDATE_NOTIFICATION=true NODE_ENV=production HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} NPM_CONFIG_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=false NPM_CONFIG_FUND=false NPM_CONFIG_AUDIT=false; if [ -d .git ] && [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then git pull --ff-only || echo "git pull failed: starting what is here"; fi; if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "Making a new Strapi project"; rm -rf .raptor-new; npx -y "create-strapi@{{STRAPI_VERSION}}" .raptor-new --non-interactive --no-run --skip-cloud --dbclient sqlite --use-npm --no-example --typescript --no-git-init --no-install || exit 1; (shopt -s dotglob; mv .raptor-new/* .) && rmdir .raptor-new || exit 1; fi; h=$(cat package.json package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi || exit 1; node_modules/.bin/strapi telemetry:disable >/dev/null 2>&1; h=$(cat package.json package-lock.json | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); echo "$h" > node_modules/.raptor-installed; fi; b=$({ cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null; find src config -type f -print0 2>/dev/null | sort -z | xargs -0 cat; } | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); if [ "$b" != "$(cat .raptor-built 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Building the admin panel"; npm run build || { echo "The build failed. If it was killed, give the server more memory (about 3 GB)."; exit 1; }; echo "$b" > .raptor-built; fi; exec node_modules/.bin/strapi start

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Strapi: clones your project's Git repository, if one is set, or checks
# the Strapi version a new project is made with on the first start. Files
# already in the server's folder (your project, its database and uploads)
# are never deleted or overwritten.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" ]; then
    url="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    case "$url" in *.git) ;; *) url="$url.git" ;; esac
    if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
        url="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${url#https://}"
    fi
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo "The repository is already here: pulling the latest changes."
        git pull --ff-only
    elif [ -f package.json ]; then
        echo "The folder already has a project that isn't a Git repository, so nothing was cloned."
    else
        git clone --depth 1 ${GIT_BRANCH:+--branch "$GIT_BRANCH"} "$url" .raptor-clone
        (shopt -s dotglob; mv .raptor-clone/* .)
        rmdir .raptor-clone
    fi
    echo "Installed. Strapi's packages are installed and its admin panel built on the first start."
    exit 0
fi

if [ -f package.json ]; then
    echo "The project is already here. Strapi's packages and admin panel are updated at start when they change."
    exit 0
fi
version="${STRAPI_VERSION:-latest}"
code=$(curl -sS --retry 3 -A "raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://registry.npmjs.org/create-strapi/$version") ||
    fail "npm's registry can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ "$code" = 200 ] || fail "Strapi has no version $version. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 5.62.0, then reinstall."
echo "Installed. A new Strapi $version project is made on the first start."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Strapi version a new project is made with, such as 5.62.0, or latest. A project from Git or one already made keeps its own.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: An https link to your Strapi project's repository, cloned when the server is installed. Leave it empty to make a new project.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: The branch to clone. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Your username on the Git host, for a private repository.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: An access token that can read the private repository.

variables.name: Pull updates at start
variables.description: Pull the repository's latest changes every time the server starts.
